summary: Enlivex Ltd. filed a 6-K furnishing a press release reporting 12-month topline data from the randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase IIa stage of its Phase I/IIa trial (ENX-CL-05-001) of Allocetra in moderate-to-severe knee osteoarthritis. In patients aged 64+, 79.2% of Allocetra recipients achieved a clinically meaningful response versus 47.6% on placebo (p=0.027), consistent with 3- and 6-month results; data will be presented at ACR Convergence on November 8, 2026. No transaction, capital event, or board recommendation is involved; this is a routine clinical-results disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
